connectionSpecification.description: Reads tickets, users, ticket events, organizations, groups, ticket fields and satisfaction ratings from Zendesk Support with an API token.

api_token.description: Zendesk API token (Admin Center > Apps and integrations > Zendesk API). It is sent in the Authorization header.
api_token.title: API Token

email.description: Email of the admin the API token belongs to.
email.title: Email

start_date.description: Earliest update the first sync of tickets, users and ticket events reads: an RFC 3339 time or YYYY-MM-DD, in UTC.
start_date.title: Start Date

subdomain.description: Account name of your Zendesk, such as acme for https://acme.zendesk.com.
subdomain.title: Subdomain

connectionSpecification.title: Zendesk Support Source Spec
